summary: Tested httpOnly-cookie impersonation flow. Backend pytest: 5/5 PASSED (impersonate sets httpOnly+secure+samesite=lax cookie, /auth/me via cookie returns role=operator with impersonated_by, return-from-impersonate sets admin cookie correctly & resets role, 400 when not impersonating, session persists across multiple requests). Frontend Playwright: admin login + navigation to /admin/operators works, action menu opens, 'Login as Operator' menu item is clickable, but the UI showed a red toast 'Failed to impersonate operator' after clicking, and no impersonation banner / Return-to-Admin button rendered. Because the exact same endpoint succeeds from pytest using admin@saas.com+Demo operator, the failure appears to be on the frontend side (handleImpersonate catch block likely triggered by refreshCurrentUser or response handling after cookie set).

ui_bugs.issue: Menu action is labelled 'Login as Operator' while task/spec refers to an 'Impersonate' button - labelling inconsistency (minor)

integration_issues.issue: Clicking 'Login as Operator' shows red toast 'Failed to impersonate operator'. Backend endpoint POST /api/admin/operators/{id}/impersonate works correctly (pytest passes, 200 with httpOnly cookie). Frontend handleImpersonate in Operators.jsx (lines 352-361) catches an error - likely refreshCurrentUser() or post-call navigation failing. Impersonation banner and Return-to-Admin button never rendered in UI because context never switched to operator.

action_items: Debug frontend handleImpersonate in /app/frontend/src/pages/admin/Operators.jsx (line 352-361). API call likely succeeds (cookie set) but subsequent refreshCurrentUser() or navigation throws, triggering the generic 'Failed to impersonate operator' toast. Add console.error logging in the catch block and re-run to see actual error. Likely root causes: (a) refreshCurrentUser() returns an object the code destructures incorrectly, (b) response JSON parsing assumes old token-in-body shape, (c) navigation to operator dashboard fails because user state not yet updated synchronously.
Consider renaming 'Login as Operator' menu item to 'Impersonate' for consistency with spec (optional).
Add data-testid attributes: 'impersonate-operator-button' on the menu item, 'impersonation-banner', 'return-to-admin-button' to make future tests robust.

rca of the issue: Frontend-only bug. POST /api/admin/operators/{id}/impersonate returns 200 with proper Set-Cookie (verified by pytest). The React handleImpersonate calls refreshCurrentUser() after the API call but some exception thrown there (or during navigation) is caught and surfaced as generic 'Failed to impersonate operator' toast, so context never updates to operator and the banner/Return-to-Admin button never render. Mitigation: add detailed error logging in catch, verify refreshCurrentUser's contract, ensure navigate() runs after await refreshCurrentUser().
